title: Supplementary Code S1 for routine urine protein prognosis in early sepsis-associated acute kidney injury
description: Software accompanying a retrospective 72-hour landmark study of the incremental mortality discrimination provided by routine urine protein reports in adults with early sepsis-associated acute kidney injury using MIMIC-IV v3.1. The package contains seven source SQL files, frozen mortality and RRT modeling modules, an input header with no patient rows, and a portable entry point for four mortality comparisons. Exact replay requires the authorized analysis-ready input in its original row order. Local cleaning, RRT event-scenario construction, additional sensitivity orchestration and final manuscript table construction remain part of the approved local pipeline, as documented in the README. The release contains no patient-level data.
